EmailTemplate.subject: Your Qantas Freight Case {!Case.CaseNumber}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Thank you for contacting Qantas Freight.
This auto-reply is to confirm that we have received your enquiry and your case number is: {!Case.CaseNumber}.
We will get back to you as soon as possible during business hours. If you require further information, simply respond to this email.
It is important to ensure you are not emailing or responding to an old email thread that we have actioned previously, as this may result in a delay in responding.
If you need immediate support, we recommend you call contact us on 13 12 13.
All the best, Qantas Freight Team www.qantasfreight.com
